buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the

Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Minimum Qualifications & Physical Standards Age Limit: All security guards deployed must be aged between 21 and 45 years (for civilian guar ds) and up to 60 years (for Ex-Servicemen / Armed Guards). Physical Fitness: Guards must be physically fit, free from any contagious diseases, and possess v alid medical fitness certificates issued by a registered medical practitioner prior to deployment. Educational Background: Minimum qualification of 10th pass for Security Guards (Unskilled/Semi- Skilled) and 12th pass/Graduate for Security Supervisors. Character Verification: The Service Provider must submit police verification reports (PVR) for all d eployed personnel within 15 days of contract commencement. 2. Compliance with Statutory Laws & Wages Statutory Compliance: The service provider shall strictly comply with the Minimum Wages Act, EP F Act, ESI Act, Payment of Bonus Act, and PSARA (Private Security Agencies Regulation Act) as appli cable in the state/UT. Wage Proof Submission: The contractor must submit monthly proof of EPF/ESI electronic challan- cum-return (ECR) along with bank transfer statements demonstrating direct salary deposit into the i ndividual bank accounts of the guards before claiming the next bill. No Deductions: No administrative charges, uniform costs, or registration fees shall be illegally ded ucted by the vendor from the wages of the security personnel. 3. Uniform, Equipment & Infrastructure Uniform & Gear: The contractor must provide two pairs of full uniforms, shoes, whistles, torches ( with batteries), high-visibility jackets, and identity cards to each security guard per year at no additi onal cost to the buyer. Arms & Ammunition (If applicable): Armed security guards must possess valid personal gun lice nses issued by competent authorities, and all weapons supplied must be in fully functional condition . 4. Operational Responsibilities & Attendance Shift Management: Guards will work on standard 8-hour rotational shifts (or as mandated by local labor laws). 24/7 posts must be seamlessly covered without double-shifting individual guards conse cutively. Absence & Relief: If a guard is absent, a suitable replacement must be deployed immediately. If a post remains unmanned, a penalty per post per shift will be levied in addition to non-payment for th at shift. Biometric/Register Attendance: Attendance will be recorded via the Buyer's biometric system/d uty register. Bills will be processed strictly on verified attendance days. 5. Termination & Penalty Clauses Breach of Discipline: Sleeping on duty, intoxication, unauthorized absence, or misconduct will res ult in an immediate replacement request and a deduction of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per instance from the monthly service bill. Loss or Damage: In case of theft, pilferage, or damage to property due to security negligence, an i nternal inquiry committee will assess the loss, and the verified damage amount will be recovered di rectly from the contractor's performance bank guarantee (PBG) or monthly bills.
